name: Session-Close Consolidation
description: On session close, temporary memories are evaluated for promotion to durable memories. A consolidation policy determines which ephemeral memories become permanent.
purpose: Bridge ephemeral and durable memory — at session boundaries, automatically extract valuable context from temporary memories and promote them to permanent storage where they benefit future sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: Temporary memories are tagged with session ID
On session close, memories are evaluated against consolidation policy
Consolidation policy defines: min confidence, min recurrence, min relevance
Promoted memories are copied to durable bank with provenance
Ephemeral memories that fail consolidation are archived or evicted
Consolidation is logged with promotion decisions and reasoning
rollback_strategy: Restore pre-consolidation state; re-evaluate promotion decisions
recovery_strategy: Re-run consolidation on session journal from checkpoint
